  COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id) as receipts,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) as total_sales_net,
  SUM(fsl.quantity) as units_sold

INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN period_dates pd ON fsl.sale_date BETWEEN pd.period_start_date AND pd.period_end_date

ORDER BY ds.format

WITH period_dates AS (
  SELECT period_start_date, period_end_date
  FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
  WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period = 2
),
sales_in_period AS (
  SELECT 
    fsl.sales_line_id,
    fsl.net_amount,
    ds.format
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
  INNER JOIN period_dates pd ON fsl.sale_date BETWEEN pd.period_start_date AND pd.period_end_date
)
SELECT 
  sip.format,
  SUM(frl.refund_net) as total_refunds_net
FROM fact_return_line frl
INNER JOIN sales_in_period sip ON frl.sales_line_id = sip.sales_line_id
GROUP BY sip.format
ORDER BY sip.format

WITH period_dates AS (
  SELECT period_start_date, period_end_date
  FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
  WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period = 2
),
sales_in_period AS (
  SELECT 
    fsl.sales_line_id,
    fsl.net_amount,
    ds.format
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
  INNER JOIN period_dates pd ON fsl.sale_date BETWEEN pd.period_start_date AND pd.period_end_date
),
sales_by_format AS (
  SELECT 
    format,
    SUM(net_amount) as total_sales_net
  FROM sales_in_period
  GROUP BY format
),
returns_by_format AS (
  SELECT 
    sip.format,
    SUM(frl.refund_net) as total_refunds_net
  FROM fact_return_line frl
  INNER JOIN sales_in_period sip ON frl.sales_line_id = sip.sales_line_id
  GROUP BY sip.format
)
SELECT 
  sbf.format,
  sbf.total_sales_net,
  COALESCE(rbf.total_refunds_net, 0) as total_refunds_net,
  CASE 
    WHEN sbf.total_sales_net > 0 
    THEN ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(rbf.total_refunds_net, 0) / sbf.total_sales_net, 2)
    ELSE 0
  END as return_rate_pct
FROM sales_by_format sbf
LEFT JOIN returns_by_format rbf ON sbf.format = rbf.format
ORDER BY sbf.format

  COUNT(*) as count
FROM fact_sales_line fsl

SELECT 
  'Stores with active sales in P2',
  COUNT(DISTINCT ds.store_id)
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND dd.fiscal_period = 2
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Return lines from P2 sales',
  COUNT(*)
FROM fact_return_line frl
WHERE frl.sales_line_id IN (
  SELECT fsl.sales_line_id
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND dd.fiscal_period = 2
)
